title: Introducing the Enhanced Spyglass Tool
summary: We're excited to announce the full public launch of Spyglass, an advanced tool designed to provide you with unparalleled insights and capabilities.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: Empower yourself with our new, intuitive file management system, giving you complete control to upload, organize, and customize the appearance of all your embedded content right within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: We've launched a dedicated page where you can easily track our progress, see what's coming soon, and discover our exciting plans for the future.

title: Smarter, More Responsive Checkboxes
summary: We've made checkboxes bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable, while also updating their visual design to seamlessly blend with the rest of your experience.

title: Seamless Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've refined our editor to make collaborating with your team smoother and more intuitive than ever before.

title: Effortless Collaboration on Shared Items
summary: We've made it significantly easier to find and collaborate on items shared with your network, ensuring you always have access to relevant information.

title: Multilingual Support Arrives
summary: We're expanding Noeko to support a wide array of international languages, making it accessible to even more users worldwide.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control and transparency in its development.

title: Enhanced Constellation View
summary: Explore your entire knowledge base like never before with new filtering capabilities and shared item visibility, empowering you to navigate, discover, and collaborate more effectively.

title: Enhanced Search for Focused Discovery
summary: Discover exactly what you're looking for faster than ever with powerful new search filters, flexible date ranges, and custom sorting options, allowing you to save and revisit your focused results with ease.

title: Smarter Note Connections
summary: Seamlessly integrate and view linked information directly within your notes, offering a more intuitive and flexible way to organize your thoughts.

title: Introducing Noeko Enterprise and Self-Host Options
summary: Experience greater control and enhanced capabilities with Noeko's new self-hosting option and powerful paid plans, designed to scale with your team.

title: Elevate Your Workspace with Stunning New Themes
summary: Get ready to personalize your workspace with beautifully refined existing themes and a fresh collection of vibrant new options.

title: More Accurate Time-Based Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more personalized welcome as our app now precisely adjusts its greetings to reflect the actual time of day, enhancing your everyday experience.

title: Efficient Tag Management Actions
summary: Streamline your workflow with enhanced tag management, allowing you to quickly unapply tags and perform other essential actions directly from any tag view.

title: Unlock More Content Types
summary: Get ready to seamlessly import and interact with information from a wealth of new sources, from engaging YouTube videos to insightful websites and simple text files, truly centralizing your learning experience.
